Designed around
human movement.

We’re Ankush and Panda, and we’re building Konarc for people whose knees make everyday life harder than it should be. A walk, a flight of stairs, or simply getting on with the day can take more thought when you’re dealing with knee pain, arthritis, or a knee that needs support. We want to build something practical around those everyday needs: a sleeve with adjustable mechanical support, designed with the person wearing it in mind. We’re starting with the brace and developing a sensor-connected app alongside it, with TENS integration planned for a future product. Our reason for building is simple: to help people with knee problems feel better supported as they move through their day.

The 3D model is an illustrative design concept. Final product details may change.
